stories.title: UK inflation falls to 2.8% as energy bills drop but petrol prices hit four-year high
stories.summary: UK inflation fell to 2.8% in the year to April 2026, its lowest level since March 2025, official figures have shown. The Consumer Prices Index measure of inflation was down from 3.3% in the year to March, the Office for National Statistics said. stories.title: Heading into Chester this summer? Here is what police are doing to keep people safe
stories.summary: Cheshire Police have launched a summer safety campaign in Chester targeting drugs, disorderly behaviour and violence against women and girls. stories.title: North Wales PCC welcomes £30m UK crackdown on organised crime in high street shops
stories.summary: The North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin has welcomed a £30 million UK Government crackdown on organised crime in high street shops.
